For lifting and strength training, you don't necessarily need extreme, high-bounce-control running armor, but you *do* need **stability, zero digging during overhead lifts (like shoulder presses), and a stay-put band** that won't ride up when you're benching or hinging.

The best options vary depending on your chest size and preferred fit:

#### Top Picks for Weightlifting

- [**Shefit Ultimate Sports Bra** ](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:a,pvo:29,mid:576462700836816793,imageDocid:17831045644243616392,gpcid:1932317113994862949,headlineOfferDocid:2348084392794892782,catalogid:3355065131592986024,productDocid:6345362049570182335,rds:PC_1932317113994862949%7CPROD_PC_1932317113994862949&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwir9avp64OYAxUgnf0HHS3SH8YQxa4PeggIAggBCBYQBA) 
	- **Why it works:** It features full Velcro-adjustable shoulder straps and a rib-band cinch. You can dial in the exact tension you want, meaning zero shifting during heavy barbell movements or clean-and-jerks.
	- **Great for:** Anyone who hates pull-over sports bras or struggles with standard sizing. Featured on [Wirecutter's Sports Bra Guide](https://www.nytimes.com/wirecutter/reviews/best-sports-bras/).[[1]](https://www.nytimes.com/wirecutter/reviews/best-sports-bras/)
- **Gymreapers Performance / Infinity Bra** 
	- **Why it works:** Gymreapers designs gear explicitly for powerlifting and bodybuilding. Their performance/infinity lines offer solid compression, sweat-wicking stretch-knit fabric, and wide straps that don't dig into traps during squats.
	- **Great for:** Lifters who want a rugged, no-nonsense gym aesthetic with reliable medium-to-high compression. Explore styles directly on [Gymreapers](https://www.gymreapers.com/collections/bras).[[1]](https://www.gymreapers.com/collections/bras)
- **Athleta Interval / Advance Bras** 
	- **Why it works:** Soft, buttery-smooth fabric that moves with your back and shoulders during compound lifts without pinching or rolling up.
	- **Great for:** Hypertrophy sessions, dumbbell work, and everyday training where you want comfort paired with enough hold to stay contained.
- [**Elomi Energise** ](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:a,pvo:29,imageDocid:1178630588705445776,gpcid:4275871990599042762,headlineOfferDocid:7784106287958418766,catalogid:4197625409547784689,productDocid:15785675308317818744,rds:PC_4912355263491700731%7CPROD_PC_4912355263491700731&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwir9avp64OYAxUgnf0HHS3SH8YQxa4PeggIAggBCBYQGw) 
	- **Why it works:** Unlike compression bras that squish everything down, this is an encapsulation model with separate cups and a J-hook conversion. It keeps everything anchored high and separated so you don't feel restricted when bending over.
	- **Great for:** High-capacity support under heavy loads, highlighted via [The New York Times Wirecutter](https://www.nytimes.com/wirecutter/reviews/best-sports-bras/).[[1]](https://www.nytimes.com/wirecutter/reviews/best-sports-bras/)

#### What to Look for in a Lifting Bra:

- **Strap Style:** Look for **straight, wide, or racerback/cross-back** configurations that stay clear of your scapula and bar path (avoid overly loose decorative straps that slip during benching).
- **Band Security:** A thick, firm bottom band is crucial so the bra doesn’t ride up when you arch your back on the bench press.
- **Compression vs. Encapsulation:** Lighter upper-body days do great with a soft compression crop, whereas heavy multi-joint days (deadlifts, squats, overhead presses) benefit from locked-in support that stops unwanted movement.
